注意：示例图像是人工智能生成的，并不代表真人。

除了基础知识之外，该工作流程还具有特殊功能：

  • 有一个固定的 Lora 加载器（Lora Loader Stack (rg Three)）。这是必要的，因为如果您执行不止一代，例如，如果您使用加载 LoRA 标签，则一次运行 32 代，它将加载相同的 Lora 32 次。因此，对于共享 Loras，您可以在 Lora Loader Stack (rg Three) 中设置加载一次并节省性能。

  • 缓存不浪费，是我自己开发的一个节点，可以缓存工作流程的很多部分，并在后代中跳转很多步骤，预防模型的重复加载，节省性能和时间。更多信息请点击这里

  • 液晶模组。只是一个 Lora，可以将推理步骤数量减少到仅 8 - 12 之间。在这里下载

This is my basic workflow, which I developed after many learned. It's a balance between quality, speed, performance and facilities. Every new work I will start, I start with this.

If you enjoy my work, give me a like, consider leaving a comment or supporting me. I’d really appreciate it!Buy me a Coffee.

Note: Example images are AI-generated and do not represent real people.

Beyond the basics, this workflow has special features:

  • Has a fixed Lora loader (Lora Loader Stack (rgthree)). This is necessary because if you do more than one generation with, 32 generations in one only run by eg if you use the Load LoRA Tag, it will load the same Lora 32 times. So for shared Loras you set in Lora Loader Stack (rgthree) to load once and save performance.

  • Caching to not Waste, it's a node developed by me, to cache many parts of the workflow and jump a lot of steps in future generations, precautionary the loading of models repeatedly, and save performance and time.More information here

  • LCM. Just a Lora that allows to reduce the number of inference steps to only between 8 - 12.Download here
